CreatePipeline.description_en: Creates a pipeline. A pipeline consists of a series of nodes that form a directed acyclic graph (DAG), which defines the machine learning process
CreatePipeline.description_zh: 创建工作流（Pipeline）。工作流是由一系列节点组成的有向无环图，定义了一个机器学习流程

GetPipeline.description_en: Queries the information about a pipeline

GetPipelineRun.description_en: Queries the information about a pipeline job
GetPipelineRun.description_zh: 获取工作流任务详情信息

GetPipelineRunNode.description_en: Queries information about a node. A pipeline job contains a variety of nodes
GetPipelineRunNode.description_zh: 工作流任务中包含多个节点，通过该接口获取节点的详细信息

ListPipelineRunNodeLogs.description_en: Obtains the node logs of a pipeline job
ListPipelineRunNodeLogs.description_zh: 获取工作流任务节点运行产生的日志

ListPipelineRunNodeOutputs.description_en: Queries the outputs of a pipeline node
ListPipelineRunNodeOutputs.description_zh: 获取工作流任务节点输出

ListPipelineRunNodeStatus.description_en: Queries the running status of a pipeline node
ListPipelineRunNodeStatus.description_zh: 获取工作流任务节点运行状态

ListPipelineRuns.description_en: Queries a list of pipeline jobs. Filtering, sorting, and pagination are supported for this API operation
ListPipelineRuns.description_zh: 获取工作流任务列表，支持过滤、排序和分页查询

ListPipelineRunsStatus.description_en: Queries the statuses of multiple pipeline jobs or nodes at a time
ListPipelineRunsStatus.description_zh: 批量获取工作流任务或节点的状态

UpdatePipeline.description_en: Updates the definition of a pipeline

UpdatePipelineRun.description_en: Updates a pipeline job. You can update only the name of a pipeline job
UpdatePipelineRun.description_zh: 更新工作流任务。目前仅支持修改工作流任务名称
